entry.title: Work on servers with Ansible
entry.use_when: A playbook, a test, and a rollout you can explain.
entry.freshness: Review after use; verify current external facts before relying on them.
entry.limitations: A reusable prompt for an existing assistant; tool access and authority come from the actual task.

variants.label: Diagnose a failed playbook
variants.method: Locate the first failing task and compare its inputs on one failing and one healthy target. Distinguish connection, privilege, module and application failures before changing the playbook.
variants.output: A likely failure class, the evidence for it, and one discriminating check before a repair.

variants.label: Plan a patch rollout
variants.method: Group hosts by service dependency. Define a canary, batch size, health check, reboot expectation and stop condition; resolve inventory and check-mode exceptions before execution.
variants.output: A patch playbook change plus a canary-to-batch rollout and recovery plan.

variants.label: Explain a playbook
variants.method: Walk through target resolution, variable precedence, task order and handlers using one host as the example. Highlight the step that actually changes state.
variants.output: An annotated walkthrough of the supplied playbook, not a replacement playbook.

pattern.activation: server work involves Ansible inventory, playbooks, variables, failed runs or a planned rollout.
